title: helosciadium × longipedunculatum
intro: Helosciadium × longipedunculatum, commonly known as Long-stalked Meadow Parsley, is a hybrid plant belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating digestive issues, skin conditions, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Long-stalked Meadow Parsley include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
